neighbours.label: a token in a description of something light falling or drifting through the air (snowflakes falling, seeds carried on the air, a sparrow that falls)
fire: Soft snowflakes drifted slowly down onto the silent field.
Dandelion seeds can float on the wind for many miles.
Fine ash particles remained airborne for several days.
Autumn leaves fell gently from the old maple tree.
Not a single feather falls without being seen, he said.
Volcanic dust can stay in the air for months.
Petals were falling softly around the garden bench.
Pollen grains are carried on the breeze across the valley.
quiet: Soft blankets were folded neatly on the silent bed.
Dandelion salad can be served with oil for many guests.
Fine art prices remained high for several days.
Autumn sales fell sharply from the old high in May.
Not a single vote was cast without being seen, he said.
Volcanic rock can stay in the ground for ages.
Prices were falling quickly around the holiday season.
Corn grains are carried by truck across the valley.

short: falling or drifting through the air
notes: Card: ' can' x3, ' falling' x3, ' fell' x3, ' falls' x2, ' fall' x2, ' only', ' gently', 'akes', mostly about snow, ash, seeds and sparrows. Probes: 'sparrow that falls' 0.799, 'remain airborne for' 0.648, 'snowflakes' 0.453, 'hairs can carry the seed on the air' 0.217; 'Stock prices were falling' 0.015, 'children walking' 0.005. Near misses use falling in a non-physical sense or keep the objects on the ground.
